entities.name: Rumaysa bint Milhan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Al-Rumayṣāʾ bint Milḥān, popularly known by her kunya as Umm Sulaym, was a follower or companion (Sahabiyyah) of Islamic prophet Muhammad and was one of the earliest women converts to Islam in Yathrib.
